args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 – Combined Summary (Halvorsen)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took about twice as long as planned, so timelines need a buffer.
- Companion piece: the biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks, not just faster picking.

Sources: https://blog.halvorsen.example/2026/warehouse ; https://insights.halvorsen.example/warehouse/companion
